title: An integral primitive element for a finite rational Galois extension
statement: Let Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ. For every intermediate field E of Ω/ℚ that is finite-dimensional and Galois over ℚ, there exists α ∈ E integral over ℤ such that the intermediate field of E/ℚ generated by α is all of E.
lean_statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E], ∃ α : E, IsIntegral ℤ α ∧ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({α} : Set E) = ⊤
